items.name: ou-formal-system
items.description: A formal axiomatic system in Lean 4 built from the act of distinction. Zero imports in the foundation file. 406 declarations, zero sorry, zero declared axioms. Axiom-free categoricity, inexhaustibility, and ground determination. Clean constructive/classical partition. Cayley-Dickson cascade. Nine ZFC axioms reduced to 7 across a 3-1-3 distribution.
